findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "ДеТЯМ ИНТЕРЕСНО РаСТИ. ВМЕСТЕ С НАДЕЖДИКоМ." → 3 lines (6 words, 227.4px); "Интересно пробовать. Здорово получаться." → 4 lines (4 words, 49px); "ПОДБЕРЁМ ЗАНЯТИЕ ВАШЕМУ РЕБЁНКУ" → 3 lines (4 words, 148.3px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "2–11 лет" above "ДеТЯМ ИНТЕРЕСНО РаСТИ. ВМЕСТЕ С НАДЕЖДИК"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "О нас" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "О нас" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Занятия" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Занятия" 3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "ДеТЯМ ИНТЕРЕСНО" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "РаСТИ." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "ВМЕСТЕ С НАДЕЖДИКоМ." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Спорт" (screen 5, 38% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "У каждого — свой интерес" (screen 6, 100% over a picture); "АКАДЕМИЯ ФУТБОЛА" (screen 7, 100% over a picture); "НАДЕЖДИК ЮНИОР" (screen 7, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (3.2:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: The margins differ: 16px on the left, 3px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
